description: Diagnose HPC runtime and scheduler problems for materials simulations, including MPI/OpenMP/GPU layout, modules, CUDA/Kokkos hints, scratch paths, walltime, job arrays, restart strategy, scheduler portability, and resource mismatch. Use when an ALREADY-SUBMITTED job failed, ran slowly, got killed, or behaved differently on a cluster than on a workstation. To author or vet a NEW submission script before running, use slurm-job-script-generator instead.
